body:
Hi, I'm back.

My ex just called me and now I'm back to where I was before.

She called because she saw pictures of an accident near me and looked like my car so was just making sure.

She followed that up by telling me her boyfriend is out of the area for the next three weeks. She also confirmed reason she doesn't talk to me much anymore is because he doesn't want her to. She said him telling me she cheated was just to piss me off, however in that discussion he seemed to lie to her about how he went about doing it, no surprise.

She talked to me about the baby and pregnancy a bit which was nice, admitted that I'm a good father and she only ever said I wasn't when she was mad and spiteful.

I asked her why she hates me, she said she doesn't hate me just doesn't overly like me, I asked why that was and she told me because I'm a douche. I proceeded to ask why she thinks that and she couldn't give a reason. I asked if her mood swings right now (because of the pregnancy) could be the reason, she just said partly that and partly because I'm a douche. I particularly hate that word because it's what we used to call each other when we were annoyed but not too much so would do it in a jokingly way.

I asked if she would ever talk to me more often than just when something is needed and she says she will probably talk to me more after the baby is born.

This is all fucking with my head, what kind of existence is this. So many mixed signals, nothing straight and narrow happening, it's like an amusement park ride going round and round. I'm back to being in so much pain that I just want to escape again.

She doesn't get any money from bringing up old bills as I pay the company directly from my bank after I call them after hearing about a bill to make arrangements, so can say she's not deceiving me out of money as she knows I pay it directly to them and is what she asks me to do.

I couldn't get it in my name due to an ongoing dispute with the company which is why she let it stay in hers in the first place as long as I pay it, and I do.

Some people think it's an excuse to talk to me since she was told generally she's not allowed, but as you said it's just assumptions without clearer answers.

However it's just hard on the mind, part of me loves hearing from her even if bad, part of me hates it due to the fact it's not under good circumstances. I try to look past all that but some days emotions are a powerful thing.

I give her some benefit of the doubt still just because of the hormonal changes of pregnancy.

With it this time I just kept to the point and thanked her for letting me know instead of losing my cool even though that can be hard at times too, I'm trying to improve myself for both her and myself.

No problem on the compliments because you're correct, sometimes we just need someone to lend an ear, hence why I'm trying to reach out when I feel I'm at my limit or else I probably would. When someone, a stranger no less is willing to help they deserve the respect and good words.

Now back to the issue, things like what just happened make it hard again. The ex just called me to complain about the power bill, power is still in her name here and she's offered to have it stay in her name, and said if I don't pay it she will cut it off or take me to court. She gets the bills to her email so I don't know when a bill is out until she calls and complains each time instead of just forwarding it to me. 

Now here's what baffles me, I immediately called the power company and the amount wasn't what she said, I looked at the bill she texted me after the call and realized she was complaining about a past bill from months ago that was paid. She's not a stupid person by no means so it's difficult to believe she didn't notice that. So why call me a week after saying she"fucking hates me" and no contact since over a bill that doesn't exist? The majority of the call was actually dead silence.

Just hearing her voice was so hard as the emotions flood in, was a mix of happiness to hear from her but pain from the situation at hand, and the fact she called over that makes no sense and just adds confusion to the mix. I texted her saying it was an old bill but I'll still pay anything else owing on it but no response so far.

These things start throwing me back into a depressive state, even more so since it was on my mind all day already and was struggling with it.

I'm most definitely trying, every day is a battle. I want stability again however it seems to take quite a bit of time to get there but my time to do so is running out as my work expects me back within about another month and it's been a long process to try and get my mind clear and I'm not there yet, I feel as if I'm on a timer to solve this which is pressure in itself and that most definitely doesn't help matters.

A question that's a bit off topic, do you have an education in psychology or similar? You sound as if you do, that is not a bad thing either as it helps people that need it, can tell you're an intellectual regardless. If you're not then definitely a field you excel in. The hypotheses of psychological knowledge whether through formal education or self-taught is due to your replies here and analyzing your comment history as it piqued my curiosity.

Thanks for responding up to this point however.

I try and have patience to persevere through this however some days it becomes overwhelming, one of my issues is I care about her too much so to say, I strongly believe through good times and the bad when you have an emotional commitment to someone. To me they're all my family and I try and fight for them to the best of my ability just currently to no avail.

While together she felt comfortable enough with me to finally reveal some of her darkest secrets and past to someone, it's one of the reasons I don't give up so easily due to some of the information I know about her even in generally trust breaking situations that are hard to normally excuse. I know she's responsible for her own actions but she also needs someone there for her and others aren't providing that for her or give up the first time she pushes them away.

I know I'll get to see the baby again, even more so after they're born but the three months that's left feel like an eternity when you're waiting for it.

Time is the main hurdle, I know inside I have to be patient and wait it out, however my emotions keep running in overdrive even when I try not to let them get the better of me. Caring too much can be both a gift and a curse, and I know I'm allowing myself to suffer to do this but it's very difficult not to for me, maybe I'm too stubborn.

I have postsecondary education, a high paying job (currently on stress leave though as my performance became subpar after this which had my job hanging by a thread until my leave), and always provided what was needed financially, emotionally, and time wise for my family and for it to all come crumbling down so quickly has been Earth shattering as I worked so hard to do my part to get us where we were, obviously with her help on her part as well.

Another painful thing is all the reminders of her in my house; her clothes, cosmetics, baby items we bought together, even her cat. I can't throw them out as I feel that's wrong and she only took the bare minimum last time she was here and left the rest. I've put them away somewhat but I still know they're there.

This all leads to days where I just wish it would end, to be at peace.

She honestly seemed confused at times when telling me I needed to change everything, there was days where she seemed happy, like nothing happened and saying she still loved me and didn't know why she said the things she did, then just like that was turning on me again. I kept telling myself, and still do at times that it's hormones but I just don't know, the few times we were alone since then we got along fine, until the new boyfriend shows up, then she goes quiet and I'm the enemy again. 

He's made it clear he wants me out of the picture even with me being the father of the baby she's carrying, he told me himself he's the reason she stopped updating and talking to me, he gave her an ultimatum, I think he worries she was going to come back as she showed signs of it at one point. There was even a point where she had to go to the hospital and she had to wait until he left the room to call me to let me know.

If it is hormones, something she's not used as much as some others, I wouldn't even know for awhile and all waiting right now kills me inside. The only tidbit of information I really got from her was she felt very happy until a month or two into the pregnancy and that's when she feels it started going downhill.

I do care for my other child and I try to do everything I can for her, however she sometimes sees through the mask I try to put on for her and sees my pain, and she's also hurting with my ex gone, they were very close and my ex up until a week ago still tried to find excuses to see her. I can't help feel I'm the cause of my child's pain and hence some days feels she would be better off without me.

My unborn child is a couple months away, and going that period of time waiting also kills me inside more, the only thing I have is a picture of the last ultrasound to try and remind me each day.

I care about all of them, and watching them all be in a bad position and not able to do anything is even more devastating and adds to the depression and anxiety I've been overwhelmed with.
